comment: Config for tools/m68k2c.py (see its docstring). roots: routines translated with everything they call that is not hand-ported; the task roots are the code after each task descriptor's tag (docs/NOTES.md). yield: Yield ($400). exits: $3B8 (wait for the next frame: emulated time has to pass), $C262 (inside Kgam: wait 300 frames on the VBlank flag, after sleeping at an inn), $4BF8 (reset the stack, re-enter the frame loop), $4A06 (restart), $4CB4 (hang: no free task slot). defer: entries deliberately left untranslated (none now). Addresses only. seen (optional): targets of computed jumps found only at run time (the harness report), translated like roots; none are needed now, the translator finds them all statically. contracts: the movement entry points, which call ordinary C (port/movement.c), are checked on memory and the stack pointer; registers they leave different are watched for reads.
